qa_method: Article-by-article review of the P1-001 internal Chinese RETRANSLATIONS against the official Arabic governing text, using the official English only as secondary guidance. Because P1-001 is a retranslation track (the prior candidate was materially incomplete/condensed), each article is checked for: semantic/material completeness against the Arabic (clause-segment parity and clause-by-clause coverage), terminology preservation/consistency, source traceability (Arabic-source, English-guidance, prior-candidate and semantic-QA-P1 links/hashes), and official-status boundary (internal / non-official / non-binding / non-governing). Review only — no P1-001 Chinese text or remediation data was modified. Hashes/references only; no full Arabic/English/Chinese text embedded.
